Method of Attack: Manually installed by attackers who hack into Remote Desktop Services connected directly to the Internet
Attackers scan the Internet for computers running RDP on TCP port 3389 and attempt to brute force passwords
Encrypts mapped network drives, shared virtual machine host drives, and unmapped network shares
Creates ransom notes (Info.hta and FILES ENCRYPTED.txt) and configures itself to auto-start on Windows login
Impacted Systems: Computers running Remote Desktop Services (RDP) on Windows
Attack Vector: Hacked Remote Desktop Services (RDP) with brute force password attacks
